item.title: The dog-owner dyad in air transport in the cargo hold: the human as the source of stress, the dog as emotional agent
item.description: Official data show low observed risk in the cargo hold (99.99% incident-free across 117,861 animals, US DOT 2025), yet the owner's own stress is transmitted to the dog. Acute human-to-dog transmission is experimentally measured; the work proposes the coupled-dyad model with five falsifiable predictions, risk stratification and evidence against sedation.
